description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of four different methods across two metrics: "Accuracy (%)" and "Token Count". The horizontal axis contains the categories, grouped into two distinct sections corresponding to the two metrics, with the methods ordered as CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT within each group. The chart features dual vertical value axes. The left vertical axis represents "Accuracy (%)" on a linear scale ranging from 70 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The right vertical axis represents "Token Count" on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 800, with tick labels at intervals of 100. Light dashed horizontal gridlines align with the left axis ticks. A legend at the bottom identifies the four methods by color: CoT is red, CoD is orange, CCoT is light blue, and CoUT is green. In the "Accuracy (%)" group on the left, the CoT bar is the tallest with an annotated value of 91.19, followed by the CCoT bar, which is unannotated but reaches approximately 88.5 on the left axis and features a grey shaded rectangle directly above it. The CoUT bar has an annotated value of 88.40, and the CoD bar is the shortest in this group at 80.89. In the "Token Count" group on the right, the bars are arranged in descending order of height: the CoT bar is the tallest at 676.85, followed by CoD at 534.24, CCoT at 445.91, and CoUT, which is the shortest at 354.46. All bars are outlined in black and, with the exception of the CCoT accuracy bar, are annotated with their exact numerical values centered above them.
